kinds.d: Flour milled from rye, mostly mixed with wheat because rye lacks enough gluten.
Flour milled from rice, brown or white, or glutinous.
Flour milled from chickpeas, used in Indian cooking and Ligurian farinata.
Flour milled from whole maize; cornflour starch is not this kind.
Dried flour of nixtamalised maize dough, used for tortillas and tamales.
Flour milled from buckwheat, used in soba, blini and Breton crêpes.
Flour milled from pearl or other millets.
Flour milled from black gram or mung beans.
Pure starches for thickening: cornflour (cornstarch), arrowroot, potato and tapioca starch.
Ready-mixed gluten-free flours, either all-purpose 1-to-1 blends or yeast-dough blends.

brands.d: Maker of Maseca, the first commercial masa harina in Mexico.

notes: Doves Farm not found on a retrieved page so omitted. Urad and moong merged. Millet flour and urad/moong definitions kept from old data (Wikipedia Flour page does not cover them). Mochiko as t of rice flour from Mochi page.
